These links are for Cook County Residents.  Please see the sidebar on the right for additional counties.

When to Re-Register

Your registration is permanent unless you move or change your name. You may update an existing registration via the link Register to Vote or Update an Existing Registration on the Illinois Online Voter Registration webpage.

If you are legally changing your name at the Secretary of State’s office, you can ask them to process a new or updated voter registration.

Click the County that you reside in to get the most accurate voting and early voting information.
